name: drift-quality-evaluation
description: JEV criteria for evaluating optimal configuration drift remediation actions based on system state, impact, and historical outcomes

options.description: Revert the system to its last known good baseline configuration
Update the expected baseline to match the current configuration
Flag for manual review before taking automated action
Automatically remediate and validate system behavior before committing
Roll back changes incrementally to isolate the problematic modification

evaluation_factors: Drift severity, impact on services, and last incident recency
User feedback scores and satisfaction ratings for current configuration state
Historical success rates for each remediation action in similar drift scenarios
Time sensitivity and potential impact on users during remediation process
Risk of introducing new issues with more invasive drift approaches
